texts.preamble: Safety And Standards Act vs In Re : Mr. Supravat Paul on 8 July, 2022 Author: Debangsu Basak Bench: Debangsu Basak 08.07.2022 Kaushik Rejected C.R.M.(A) 3228 of 2022 In Re:- An application for anticipatory bail under Section 438 of the Code of Criminal Procedure in connection with Madhyamgram Police Station Case No. 208 of 2022 dated 28.04.2022 under Sections 272/273/420/120B of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 read with Sections 56/57/63 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006. And In Re : Mr. Supravat Paul ...... petitioner Mr. Debayan Bhattacharya Mr. Sandipan Dutta Ms. Swarnali Saha Mr. Rajdeep Sinha ....for the petitioner Mr. Ranabir Roychowdhury Mr. Sandip Chakraborty Mr. Kanchan Roy ....for the State
texts.arguments: Learned advocate appearing for the petitioner submits that, the petitioner was falsely implicated. He submits that one of the co-accused was enlarged on anticipatory bail. Learned advocate appearing for the State submits that, the petitioner is the owner of the set up. He refers to the chemical examination report. It appears that the petitioner is engaged in the business of supplying substandard water for human consumption to the members of the public after manufacturing and packaging the same.
